verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents a venture capital practice advising high-growth companies through funding rounds to exit. Its TwoVenture hub has a 'Start & Seed' section for start-ups, and it advises start-ups on incentives. That implies early-stage company work, but nothing explicitly documents incorporation services. Missing for 10: explicit company formation or incorporation offering, charter/articles and bylaws drafting, initial board consents, founder stock purchase agreements, and independent corroboration that formation is a core of the practice.
